name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Thalamic Override Spike
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Thalamic Override Spike
description:
The Thalamic Override Spike is a cranial BCI implant positioned through a minimally invasive transcranial procedure to place a micro-electrode array in contact with the thalamic relay nuclei. In its marketed configuration, the device functions as a high-performance sensory filter — allowing the user to selectively suppress overwhelming sensory input during combat operations, reducing the cognitive load of information-dense environments and providing resistance to disorienting electronic warfare stimuli such as strobe emitters and sonic disruptors. Arcturus markets it exclusively to licensed military and corporate security contractors as a force-multiplier for personnel operating in contested electronic environments.

The Spike's secondary and classified capability — acknowledged only in ADS's restricted-distribution technical documentation — is a remote interrupt function accessible to authorized command infrastructure. A coded signal delivered through any compatible ADS communications network can trigger a temporary suppression of the implanted subject's voluntary motor control, rendering them compliant without producing unconsciousness. This function is framed in documentation as a 'safety override for compromised personnel' but is widely understood in the intelligence community as a loyalty enforcement mechanism. The interrupt lasts between 30 seconds and 4 minutes depending on signal strength and individual neurological variance.

The Thalamic Override Spike is standard issue in several Arcturus-contracted private military units and is a known implant in corporate security divisions that have deep ADS service agreements. Its existence in civilian populations is almost always the result of coercive implantation — either as a condition of employment in certain high-security roles, or as a punitive measure applied to individuals under corporate correctional jurisdiction.

cultural_context: The Thalamic Override Spike is one of the most politically charged implants in GLMZ. Several high-profile legal cases brought by former corporate security personnel have argued that coercive implantation as a condition of employment constitutes a fundamental violation of bodily autonomy under the city's Basic Compact statutes — all of these cases have been settled quietly out of public record. Underground neurosurgeons who specialize in removal of the Spike are among the most sought-after and protected figures in the city's dissident networks, and ADS is known to actively pursue them.

story_hooks: A crew member with an ADS Spike discovers their interrupt function has been quietly reactivated after they believed it was decommissioned — someone inside ADS's command infrastructure has them flagged as a target.
An underground neurosurgeon who specializes in Spike removal has been taken by ADS operatives — the dissident network they serve desperately needs them back, and the crew is the only option.

A Spike-implanted corporate security officer wants to defect and bring intelligence with them, but their handler can trigger the interrupt at any moment — the crew must execute the extraction faster than the authentication signal can be processed.

Evidence surfaces that ADS has been secretly issuing Spike implants to civilian employees of a corporate partner without disclosure, buried in a 200-page employment contract — the journalist who found it needs protection and the crew needs to decide how far up the story goes.
